chunks: And ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, surely loves traveling away from one’s home in pursuit of sustenance.

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the narrator from whom the teaching is reported
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the Blessed and Exalted Lord
key_terms.الِاغْتِرَابَ: traveling away from one’s homeland or residing away from home
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted; a formula of glorification for Allah

ai.seo_question: Does Allah love traveling to seek sustenance?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, loves that a person journeys and exerts effort in seeking lawful sustenance. It highlights the virtue of striving for rizq and not remaining idle when pursuing one’s livelihood.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3571 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, loves traveling in pursuit of sustenance."
